# Issue Templates

This directory contains issue templates for the TopoGPT3 repository. These templates help maintainers understand and triage incoming issues efficiently.

## Available Templates

| Template | Purpose | File |
|----------|---------|------|
| Bug report | Report defects, crashes, or unexpected behavior | [bug_report.md](bug_report.md) |
| Feature request | Propose new functionality or enhancements | [feature_request.md](feature_request.md) |
| Custom issue | General issues that do not fit the above categories | [custom.md](custom.md) |

## How to Use

When creating a new issue on GitHub, select the template that best matches your report. Fill in all requested sections to ensure the issue can be addressed promptly.

## Guidelines

- Search existing issues before opening a new one to avoid duplicates.
- Provide minimal reproduction steps for bug reports.
- Explain the motivation and expected impact for feature requests.
- Keep titles concise and descriptive.
